question: Who was the captain of the Indian hockey men's team in the 1936 Berlin Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dhyan Chand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhyan Chand:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian field hockey player and captain. **
 
• He is often regarded as India's greatest hockey player and one of the world's best hockey players ever.
 
• He started playing hockey in local clubs before joining the Indian Army in 1926.
 
• **In the 1936 Berlin Olympics he was the captain, and India defeated Germany 8-1 in the final to win their third consecutive gold medal. **
 
• Chand scored three goals in the match, and he was named the player of the tournament.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ahmed Sher Khan:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian field hockey player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. **
 
• He was a member of the Indian field hockey team, which won the gold medal.
 
• His son Aslam Sher Khan is also a hockey player who was a part of the gold-winning Indian hockey team at the 1975 World Cup.
 
 
 
• **Roop Singh:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian field hockey player who was part of the Indian field hockey team, which won gold medals for India at the 1932 and 1936 Olympic Games. **
 
• He was the younger brother of Dhyan Chand, the most celebrated player in Indian hockey and widely regarded as the greatest hockey player ever.
 
 
 
• **Sayed Mohammad Jaffar Shah:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian field hockey player who competed in the 1932 and 1936 Summer Olympics. **
 
• He was considered one of the best players in the world on the "left-out" position.
